scope: endpoint controls, real external panel applicability, bounded repair pilot, prospective environment preparation
recovery_owner: remote Codex coordinator under supervise.py; master heartbeat verifies scientific completion

executor.role: implementation and execution, not measured solver
executor.auth_evidence: codex login status: Logged in using ChatGPT

allowance.shared_consumers: master and regular implementation workers; allowance is shared
allowance.estimate: one bounded implementation worker, roughly 20000-60000 tokens; actual allowance cost unknown
allowance.finishing_reserve: retain at least 25 percent; do not start a new expensive batch at 10 percent

recovery.healthy_children: adopt, never kill to recover coordinator
recovery.fallback: master verifies an eligible supported executor if primary fails; no scientific-model substitution
recovery.notification: same-thread Codex heartbeat; no email or collaborator messages

health.shared_dfs_gate: FAIL free-percent; large artifacts and runs use local scratch, not shared DFS
health.warnings: unused older CLI binaries; canonical Codex executable selected

scientific_bounds.model_and_cell_manifest: must be concretely frozen before measured calls; current file admits implementation and endpoint controls

publication: explicit owned paths on main after deterministic tests; preserve concurrent work; runtime acknowledgement records exact source revision and hashes
terminal_contract: worker_completion.json includes stage status, remaining dependencies, full denominators, output hashes and published commit; master verifies evidence before claiming completion
